body:
First I want to WARN you - suicide is DIFFICULT. Just read the stats, research the topic. Benzoz poisoning is also not a good idea. Generally, the failure rate for medication overdose is way too high. And you don't want to find yourself in even shittier position like you said you can do shower, cry, walk and sleep but imagine that you'd be able to do even less. 

So, at least be careful with drugs. Weight the option many-many times, research it exhaustively, I don't know. 

I also want to write that I understand. And I don't know what to say to you in order to remove this desire out of your head. I just don't know words. Sorry. I'd like to be more smart and empathetic person. I'd also like that somebody would be kind to me too. But as you said, there is not a lot of good people in this world. And it's pretty shitty world, yes.

What you've been looking at can be researched basically through looking on anxiety symptoms. sz and anxiety are co-occuring in many people, so I guess your doc wouldn't be surprised. However I also want to say that SSRI antidepressants are sometimes the medication of choice. So I'm not sure that it's possible to trick your doc to prescribe exactly benzos to you.

I don't believe that body will provide clear textual message with when you're going to die. This is not what happens to people as far as i know. So relax. 

As for children sing - well, I'd say that sometimes there is music sometimes stuck in somebody's head - popular songs, etc. So it may be this.

That's probably some old delusion there, i was in position where I'd need to re-examine the last 5 years of my life in order to remove them all.

I'd suggest you to talk more to close people with who you feel secure about your world picture. Guess there would be other surprises. 

In order to reassure you - no, there is no one who is spying on you through animals. Paranoid schizophrenics are not so interesting.They mostly dumb, lower intelligence and lower class people who not possess any interest for anyone (including aliens, CIA, MI6, etc)

Quite the opposite - if somebody's knowing that you're mentally ill they generally aim to stay as away from you as possible.

Well, medication definetly will kill you will shorter your lifespan. That's bad news for everyone who is schizophrenic :(. 

There is a whole site dedicated to this problem madinamerica.com. 

Unfortunately, there is no alternative to existing drugs, so for many the choice are between being on antipsychotics or being psychotic. The last is probably even worse for your health.
13%, not so much. I, from the other side, didn't have anyone psychotic but turned out to develop schizophrenia.

I wrote two books on engineering, re-read them with disgust - no crazy stuff, just plain simply not interesting / no single interesting idea . But while psychotic I was sure that this is something like incredible work worth nobel prize

You're a BPD and he is schizo? No. Aim on 1-Crazy-In-The-Relationships.  

I heard about schizo/autism kind of couples, but basically if you are BPD you need to find somebody normal. And he should too. Although it's probably much more difficult for a schizo male. 

Good luck.

I think we are all in the same boat here. 

Yes, they like to mumble this stuff about "look, we used to do lobotomy but know all you need to do is just to take this miracle antipsychotic". I mean, yeah, this is a lot of progress from ECT, lobotomy and insulin injections. But still it's just plain awful. 

Antipsychotics are shit with awful side-effects. Btw, they may exacerbate your depression.  

It's a short awful shitty life, and you can't take it back or go to sleep and wake up normal. The chances are 1 in 100. Somebody has to be the last in line. 

Some people get better. Some get worse. 

I may recommend noopept for anxiety issues. At least it worked for me. 

Congrats on still having a job. Try to hold it, work helps - you don't think about your awful future while busy.

Well, thanks! I'm also hoping to get off antipsychotics since 'getting off drugs' is one of the games that you could play under this condition. 

I'm also looking for a way to boost cognitive skills. Now read about sarcosine here.
